title: Night Watch
wikitext:
'''The Night Watch''' is an independent policing organization created to defend [[Darkshire]] from the dangers plaguing [[Duskwood]] since [[Stormwind]] pulled all of their troops away. The two most prominent dangers are the [[undead]] of [[Raven Hill]] Cemetary and [[Tranquil Gardens Cemetery]] and the [[Worgen]] of [[Brightwood Grove]] and [[Roland's Doom]].
